I see an issue in this " Servertype: POP-mailserver Servername: imap.one.com"

most providers don't work for fetching pop mail from an IMAP server.

I looked at the one website https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007365798-How-do-I-update-my-POP-mail-server-settings They offer the following as POP and SMTP mail server settings

Incoming mail (POP): Server: pop.one.com Port: 995 Encryption: SSL/TLS Outgoing mail (SMTP): Server: send.one.com Port: 465 Encryption: SSL/TLS Verification: same as for the incoming server (username and password)

I suggest you change the server name to the one posted by your mail provider and see if that works better. I have a feeling it will!
